boundary_decisions.self_reference: reference to the subject position attributed to Luna itself within a bounded cognitive cycle or continuity chain
boundary_decisions.identity_reference: reference to a stable existence/agent-definition boundary; not the same as all self-state content
boundary_decisions.identity_attribution_candidate: candidate that proposes how a subject should be identified or disambiguated
boundary_decisions.self_attribution_candidate: candidate that proposes which evidence-bearing property belongs to self under bounded confidence
boundary_decisions.self_continuity_candidate: candidate that proposes how self-linked state persists or changes across cycles
